en: Black-and-white image of a railway station area with multiple train tracks in the foreground and platforms with people walking or waiting. On the right is a brick station building with a steep tiled roof, tall arched windows, a round clock on the gable, and an entrance canopy. In the background are mid‑century office and residential buildings, trees, and low hills. Overhead power lines for electric trains cross the scene. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Sundsvall Central Station in Swedish. Additional commercial signage is visible on a large building behind the station.
